description: Learner-matched crypto spot reference (DESIGN_V1 section 23; CANDIDATES builder row 20): LightGBM with se1_lgbm_mm's params on the champion's features + the crypto aux family (se-aux-crypto-v1: for crypto template markets mapped from the sidecar series slug, Binance spot log returns over 5 min / 30 min / 2 h / 24 h and realised volatility from klines closed before the capture start, the up/down window length and start relative to the origin, the spot z-score and normal-reference gap of started up/down windows, and the market's own empirical beta to spot from earlier 2 h pairs applied to the latest pair).
